vehnar-unid-civil-atacar-2.texto: I'll give it a shot, commander.

vehnar-unid-veiculo-sel-2.texto: Armor's up to spec. Go ahead.

vehnar-sala-1.texto: Barão-Forja on the line. The furnaces of Kessari are burning, commander.

vehnar-sala-2.texto: The Consortium never sleeps, commander. Neither do the assembly lines.

vehnar-sala-3.texto: Contract signed, shift started. Let's turn a profit on this war.

vehnar-lider-era.texto: New era, new machinery. Production is rising.

vehnar-lider-superarma.texto: The Foundry is ready. Pick the delivery point.

vehnar-lider-base-atacada.texto: They're in our factory! Hold the line!

vehnar-lider-inimigo-eliminado.texto: One less competitor on the market.

vehnar-lider-vitoria.texto: The Rift is ours. Good business, commander.

vehnar-lider-derrota.texto: Bank the furnaces. We'll be back with more steel.

vehnar-lider-traicao.texto: They broke the contract! No one forgets a debt.

vehnar-lider-tempestade.texto: The Aether is boiling. Protect the drones and sensors.

vehnar-lider-ascensao.texto: Industrial Revolution! Now the world works for us.

vehnar-lider-retomada.texto: Back in command. The mission picks up where it left off.

erevane-sala-1.texto: Vesper Ísk. No one sees us coming. No one sees us leave.

erevane-sala-2.texto: Vesper Ísk. What is theirs is already ours. They just don't know it.

erevane-sala-3.texto: Speak softly, commander. The shadows are listening.

erevane-lider-era.texto: A new era. More shadows to hide in.

erevane-lider-superarma.texto: The Blackout is ready. Say when to kill the lights.

erevane-lider-base-atacada.texto: They found us. Make them regret it.

erevane-lider-inimigo-eliminado.texto: Another one who never saw it coming.

erevane-lider-vitoria.texto: The Rift is ours. And no one saw how.

erevane-lider-derrota.texto: Fall back into the shadows. We will return.

erevane-lider-ascensao.texto: Total Veil. Now we are only a whisper.

erevane-lider-retomada.texto: Back in command. The mission picks up where it left off.

tessara-unid-drone-sel-3.texto: I see everything from up here.

tessara-sala-1.texto: Sylvia Oriel. Oriel grows. And those who resist become compost.

tessara-sala-2.texto: Patience, commander. Every garden starts with a seed.

tessara-sala-3.texto: Sylvia Oriel. I cultivate what serves. I uproot what doesn't.

tessara-lider-era.texto: A new era. The garden grows another ring.

tessara-lider-superarma.texto: The Evolutionary Leap is ripe. Say when to harvest.

tessara-lider-base-atacada.texto: They're trampling my garden. Let them become compost.

tessara-lider-vitoria.texto: The Rift blooms for us. I said it would grow.

tessara-lider-derrota.texto: Fall back. Seeds wait for winter to pass.

tessara-lider-pacto.texto: Pact sealed. Until the graft takes.

tessara-lider-traicao.texto: Betrayal. I pull rotten roots myself.

tessara-lider-tempestade.texto: The Aether is boiling. Close the leaves and wait.

tessara-lider-ascensao.texto: Bloom! Now they'll understand what growing means.

tessara-lider-retomada.texto: Back in command. The mission picks up where it left off.

quorith-unid-suporte-sel-3.texto: One more voice in the chord.

quorith-sala-1.texto: Zayin Coral. The Choir sings with a single voice. Get in tune, commander.

quorith-sala-2.texto: We are many, commander. And all of us hear you.

quorith-sala-3.texto: Zayin Coral. A perfect chord begins with a steady note.

quorith-lider-era.texto: A new era. The Choir gains more voices.

quorith-lider-superarma.texto: The Unison is in tune. Name the key, commander.

quorith-lider-base-atacada.texto: Dissonance in our base. Silence them!

quorith-lider-inimigo-eliminado.texto: One voice fewer in the world. More silence.

quorith-lider-vitoria.texto: The Rift sings with us. With a single voice.

quorith-lider-derrota.texto: Fall back. The Choir will tune itself again.

quorith-lider-pacto.texto: Pact sealed. Two voices, for now.

quorith-lider-traicao.texto: Betrayal! A false note we will not forget.

quorith-lider-tempestade.texto: The Aether is boiling. Even the crystal trembles.

quorith-lider-ascensao.texto: Full Choir! Now the whole world sings.

quorith-lider-retomada.texto: Back in command. The mission picks up where it left off.

vorag-sala-1.texto: Oru Voraz. The hunger of Velk never ends.

vorag-sala-2.texto: Oru Voraz. Fresh meat on the map. Good.

vorag-sala-3.texto: Feed the Brood, commander. Or it eats you.

vorag-lider-superarma.texto: Eggs ready. Say where to hatch.

vorag-lider-base-atacada.texto: They eat our nest! Eat them first!

vorag-lider-inimigo-eliminado.texto: One less. More meat for us.

vorag-lider-pacto.texto: Pact. For now, we don't eat you.

vorag-lider-tempestade.texto: The Aether is boiling. Hide the clutch.

vorag-lider-ascensao.texto: Endless Hunger! Now everything is food.

vorag-lider-retomada.texto: Back in command. The mission picks up where it left off.

a4m3-0-vehnar.texto: Five Races, one seat. The Alignment closes today: whoever is left standing decides what the Rift spits out.

i-vehnar-0-vehnar.texto: Siphoners on the Reactors every minute. That's sabotage, and sabotage comes with a price.

i-vehnar-1-vehnar.texto: Assembly Lines at full capacity. Twenty-five combat units before the shift ends.

i-erevane-0-erevane.texto: No army. No noise. Only light fingers and a good hiding place.

i-erevane-1-erevane.texto: Fifteen hundred in stolen resources, and not one of our tanks on the map.

i-tessara-0-tessara.texto: We begin in the dark: without sun, the Core's Photosynthesis yields little.

i-tessara-1-tessara.texto: Adapt. Gain Traits. When day comes, bloom and win.

i-quorith-0-quorith.texto: A lone voice is almost silence. The Choir only wins in chord.

i-quorith-1-quorith.texto: Destroy the enemy without leaving a single voice alone on the field.

i-vorag-0-vorag.texto: Wrecks everywhere. Fat Outposts on the other side.

i-vorag-1-vorag.texto: Devour. Two thousand biomass before the eclipse passes.
